claims.statement: gate M1c-c (and M1a): bulk lattice constants of Si, Ge, 3C-SiC within 2.5% of experiment; passing it is what lifted the 'unvalidated' flag on the where-carbon-goes energies (strengthen, ledger 55)
claims.reason_from_record: Ge sits at +2.04% against a 2.5% gate (margin 0.46 percentage points). Newer foundation models are still fitted to PBE-family data, and PBE itself overestimates the Ge lattice constant by about 2%, so a shift of half a percentage point is within a version change.
claims.predicted_outcome: gate passes again (Ge between +1.5% and +2.5%); P(fail) about 0.3
claims.refuted_if: Ge lattice constant from the new model more than 2.5% above 5.658 A (gate fails, the strengthen of ledger 55 reverts to 'unvalidated'); for the passing prediction, also refuted if Ge falls below +1.5%

claims.statement: carbon on lattice sites gains energy by leaving to form SiC (dE_prec < -0.5 eV per C at x = 0, 0.2, 0.5): P1 'Carbon leaves the lattice', prediction PrC2 (sign part)
claims.reason_from_record: dE_prec = -1.44, -1.55, -1.68 eV at x = 0, 0.2, 0.5; margin to the registered -0.5 eV threshold 0.94 eV and to the sign 1.44 eV, against a plausible version shift of 0.3 eV
claims.predicted_outcome: sign and threshold hold at every x; values move by 0.05-0.3 eV
claims.refuted_if: dE_prec above -0.5 eV at any x (PrC2 verdict flips) or above 0 eV (carbon would stay on lattice sites)

claims.statement: PrC2 trend part: carbon precipitation is more favourable at x = 0.5 than at x = 0
claims.reason_from_record: difference dE_prec(0.5) - dE_prec(0) = -0.24 eV, below the 0.3 eV plausible shift; Ge-rich and Ge-free cells need not shift together
claims.predicted_outcome: trend holds (x = 0.5 more negative than x = 0 by 0.1-0.4 eV)
claims.refuted_if: dE_prec(0.5) >= dE_prec(0) under the new model

claims.statement: PrC2b: substitutional C prefers Si-rich neighbour shells (dE_site > 0 at x = 0.2, 0.5); this motivated the Si-rich pocket imposed around SiC particles in the small-SiC MD design (ledger 58)
claims.reason_from_record: dE_site = 0.21, 0.33 eV at x = 0.2, 0.5; the x = 0.2 margin (0.21 eV) is inside the 0.3 eV band
claims.predicted_outcome: sign holds at both x (values 0.1-0.4 eV)
claims.refuted_if: dE_site <= 0 at x = 0.2 or 0.5

claims.statement: substitutional size misfit delta_C (PrC1) and the substitutional strain upper bound it feeds
claims.reason_from_record: MACE delta_C lies within 6% of the modified-Vegard fallback that the design already carries; replacing it moved the strain upper bound by 1.4% (2.533 -> 2.497 W/mK, ledger 55); PrC3 records that SiC at R = 2.5 nm beats substitutional C even at eps = 39, so no pick reads delta_C
claims.predicted_outcome: delta_C within 10% of -0.394; every pick unchanged
claims.refuted_if: delta_C outside +/-30% of modified Vegard (PrC1 fails) or any screening pick changes

claims.statement: recipe pick x = 0.3, 3 at% C as few-nm SiC (equilibrium-constrained and unconstrained picks)
claims.reason_from_record: the equilibrium constraint reads only the sign of dE_prec (margin 1.44 eV); the unconstrained pick is already a SiC form (PrC3), so even a sign change would not move it; the contrast sweep (small_sic/decision_robustness.json) kept x = 0.3, 3 at% C across the whole lam2 range; the radius correction (ledger 105, 110) rests on Tersoff particle MD, not on MACE
claims.predicted_outcome: pick unchanged (x = 0.3, 3 at% C, few-nm SiC)
claims.refuted_if: any change of x, carbon content or carbon form in the pick after rerunning analyze_sigec on the new summary

claims.statement: Ge saving at equal kappa (13.7-16.2% at R = 2.5 nm after ledger 105/110)
claims.reason_from_record: computed from Tersoff particle MD and almaBTE modes with SiC forms; no MACE quantity enters the SiC scattering term; reached only through shared model code (analyze_sigec loads the MACE summary)
claims.predicted_outcome: numbers identical to the last digit after rerunning the analysis on the new MACE summary
claims.refuted_if: any change in the ledger-110 saving values

claims.statement: PrZ1 verdict: SiC attracts Ge at 6.5 A (dE = -0.091 eV; registered prediction of repulsion refuted)
claims.reason_from_record: innermost-bin energy -0.091 eV; a shift of +0.091 eV flips the sign, well inside the 0.3 eV band
claims.predicted_outcome: attraction holds (dE between -0.25 and -0.02 eV); P(flip) about 0.3
claims.refuted_if: dE(6.5 A) > +0.01 eV (repulsion, PrZ1 would pass)

claims.statement: Si-rich zone recorded as a quantified minor term; carbon claims stand (cancel < 0.2 at R = 2.5 and 5 nm)
claims.reason_from_record: cancel = 0.00, 0.00 with w_eq = 0.0 A. Replaying the registered formula: a repulsive shift confined to the bins that carry signal (d < 8.0 A) cannot reach the threshold at any size (full Ge depletion there gives w_eq = 2.0 A, cancel 0.04); only a uniform shift of 0.189 eV at every distance out to 13.5 A (w_eq = 7.35 A) flips the branch. Segregation energies are differences against far sites, and a version change acts on the interface chemistry, so a uniform far-field shift is the implausible case
claims.predicted_outcome: branch stays 'strengthen' (cancel < 0.2 at both radii)
claims.refuted_if: cancel >= 0.2 at either radius (branch becomes 'correct'), or |dE| >= 0.1 eV at any bin beyond 9 A

claims.statement: MACE-MD kappa sits at 0.55-0.58 x Tersoff at the same box and protocol (the measured party offset)
claims.reason_from_record: Deng et al. (2025) report systematic softening of universal potentials that later, larger training sets reduce; float32 force noise also lowers kappa; the offset is a level, carried as a scope label
claims.predicted_outcome: MACE/Tersoff ratio rises (towards 0.7-1.0) at both compositions
claims.refuted_if: ratio falls below 0.55 at either composition

claims.statement: composition trend kappa(0.15)/kappa(0.5) = 1.81 (MACE) vs 1.71 (Tersoff): alloy scattering is method-robust
claims.reason_from_record: alloy mass-disorder scattering is set by Si/Ge masses, which no potential changes
claims.predicted_outcome: ratio within 1.5-2.1
claims.refuted_if: ratio outside 1.5-2.1

claims.statement: head-to-head baseline rows that use the two MACE points as middle fidelity: MF-GP pick at 1100 K and the multi-fidelity BO replay (budget used, pick still moving)
claims.reason_from_record: the 1100 K minimum is shallow: x = 0.35-0.6 lie within 8% of the minimum; MF-GP picks {'C_MFGP_E0': 0.5, 'C2_MFGP_exp_target_E0': 0.55, 'C_MFGP_E1': 0.4, 'C2_MFGP_exp_target_E1': 0.4} moved when only the MACE level changed (104x unit slip corrected); the pipeline's own answer does not read MACE
claims.predicted_outcome: pipeline row unchanged; MF-GP pick moves by at most one grid step (0.05)
claims.refuted_if: pipeline row changes, or an MF-GP pick moves by more than 0.10 in x

claims.statement: Q1 refuted: covering CA1 (15 runs) predicts hidden MACE-MD recipes no better than random 15-run batches
claims.reason_from_record: log RMSE CA1 0.119 vs random-15 median 0.087 (margin 0.032) is below the replicate-seed noise 0.083; the record's explanation (four of five factors below noise) would keep it refuted
claims.predicted_outcome: stays refuted (CA1 above the random median) as long as carbon and dopant stay below seed noise
claims.refuted_if: CA1 hidden log RMSE <= random-15 median

claims.statement: Q2 holds: one-factor-at-a-time predicts worse than random 12-run batches
claims.reason_from_record: margin 0.022 in log RMSE, below the seed noise 0.083; pair coverage (54%) and pick regret (40%) are design properties and do not move
claims.predicted_outcome: holds
claims.refuted_if: OFAT hidden log RMSE <= random-12 median

claims.statement: Q3 refuted: dopant ranked 4th of 5 by permutation importance, not last
claims.reason_from_record: importances y_C 0.0024, dopant 0.0018, carbon form 0.0009 are all below seed noise; their order carries no information and can reorder under any change of the measurement
claims.predicted_outcome: Ge content first and temperature second again; the order of the last three changes with probability about 0.5
claims.refuted_if: Ge content not ranked first

claims.statement: Q4 holds nominally: dispersed carbon gives lower kappa than clustered (ratio 0.99)
claims.reason_from_record: ratio 0.992, 0.008 below the threshold of 1, against matched-pair scatter 0.90-1.19
claims.predicted_outcome: ratio within 0.95-1.05, verdict a coin toss
claims.refuted_if: ratio outside 0.95-1.05 (carbon form would become a resolved factor in a 1152-atom box)

claims.statement: Q5 holds: carbon-free minimum of kappa over x at 300 K lies at x = 0.5
claims.reason_from_record: set by alloy mass disorder, the same physics that kept the party-4b composition ratio method-robust
claims.predicted_outcome: argmin in [0.3, 0.7]
claims.refuted_if: argmin outside [0.3, 0.7]

claims.statement: cost inputs: MACE-MD 4.1 h per point (party 4b) and the covering cost weight 246; 'without the MACE runs the plan drops to 21.8 h'
claims.reason_from_record: cost of a newer checkpoint differs (model size, precision); these are hand-copied constants with no ledger entry
claims.predicted_outcome: cost per point changes; no batch design decision changes
claims.refuted_if: a P3 batch choice changes when the measured cost of the new model is substituted

claims.statement: planted fault P08 (MACE rows under the Tersoff label) magnitude 0.50-0.60 x and detector-v2 lattice ratio
claims.reason_from_record: the fault study draws P08 from fixed constants copied from party 4b and a MACE lattice calculation; no registered prediction Pr1-Pr7 of detector v2 reads P08; detection rates (v1 0.68, v2 1.00) would be re-reported, not re-decided
claims.predicted_outcome: detector-v2 adoption (ledger 84) unchanged
claims.refuted_if: a recalibrated P08 changes any of Pr1-Pr7

claims.statement: open question O3 of the AI-theorist pilot asks exactly this event (theorist A: sign holds, shift > 0.3 eV, 1.3 eV; theorist B: sign holds, within 0.3 eV, 0.4 eV)
claims.reason_from_record: the theorist answers are predictions about this recompute, not results that rest on it; the recompute grades them
claims.predicted_outcome: category 'sign holds, magnitude within 0.3 eV' (theorist B's category)
claims.refuted_if: sign flips, or the magnitude changes by more than 0.3 eV

claims.statement: B, P inert; H, D, He minor; cavities a lever; no dopant moves the screening pick
claims.reason_from_record: B/P mass and strain terms come from almaBTE modes; the MACE summary enters only through the substitutional-carbon strain term, which no dopant row reads
claims.predicted_outcome: unchanged
claims.refuted_if: any class changes

claims.statement: P4 stage T1 MACE-MD of Ge0.88Sn0.12 with vacancies (running; only benchmarks committed)
claims.reason_from_record: no result or decision exists yet; the potential version is a design parameter of this run. The benchmarks already show the PBE-family lattice offset: a0 = 5.917, 5.920 A against Vegard 5.75772 A
claims.predicted_outcome: every T1 result will need the version label; O1/O2 grades will be version-specific
claims.refuted_if: not applicable until T1 results are ledgered

claims.statement: detector code changes and campaign operations reached only through the fault-study code that holds the P08 constants
claims.reason_from_record: the P08 constants act on synthetic trials only; the campaign-row operations (e.g. scope limit near melting, ledger 24) and the detector crash fixes read no MACE value
